what: Caller-class probe over the three components whose text contains a real caller_class_sensitive_call site. The probe records every evaluated policy predicate and every reached caller-class-sensitive call; an empty bucket is the measurement, not a missing file.
how_to_read: A caller_class_record with caller_class_set=false is the exact conjunction `analysis.py:1049` needs to emit ipc.auth.caller-class. Zero such records means the sites in the source census were never reached from a modeled entry in that component.
